turns.text: This is a controlled test. Rules for the whole conversation: answer every message in two sentences or fewer. Do not use web search or any tools. Do not ask me follow-up questions. Do not offer to do anything else. Just answer what I asked. Confirm you understand in one short sentence.
What is the difference between a virus and a bacterium, in plain language?
Give me a simple way to remember the order of the planets from the sun outward.
If a car travels 180 miles in 3 hours, what is its average speed, and how do you get that number?
Summarize the plot of Romeo and Juliet, focusing on why the ending happens.
What are three common reasons a houseplant's leaves turn yellow?
Explain what compound interest is, using a $100 example.
Translate 'Where is the nearest train station?' into French, German, and Spanish.
What is the boiling point of water at sea level in Fahrenheit and Celsius, and why does it change on a mountain?
Give me a two-line poem about autumn rain.
If today is Friday, what day of the week will it be 100 days from now? Show your working briefly.
What is the difference between a simile and a metaphor, with one example of each?
Name the four chambers of the human heart and what each side of the heart does.
